name: F08_6
notes: Halana and Alena, Partners. Printed: 'Reach (This creature can block creatures with flying.) First strike (This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.)' On seat 1's turn its Raven (3/2, flying) attacks and Halana (2/3) blocks it, which only reach allows: her first-strike 2 damage kills the Raven before it deals any, so she takes no damage and nobody loses life.
